sources.title: Soldiers in the 10 October 2015 Pyongyang parade
sources.creator: Uwe Brodrecht
sources.limitation: The image directly records uniforms, soldiers and the visible street on that date. Its exact street viewpoint has not been matched to Kim Il Sung Square. The original filename incorrectly says 75th anniversary; the 2015 event was the 70th. This is a period reference, not proof of exact sprite placement.

sources.title: Armored parade vehicles · 10 October 2015
sources.creator: Uwe Brodrecht
sources.published: 26 March 2016 (Commons upload); first Flickr publication not verified
sources.limitation: Two long gun barrels, green vehicle structures, uniformed crew and foreground spectators are visible. Tracks or wheels are obscured, and the image alone does not identify a main battle tank or model. A generic tank sprite is inferred, not a reconstruction of this exact vehicle. The exact street viewpoint is unverified.

sources.title: Earlier tank appearance reference · 2013 Victory Day
sources.creator: Stefan Krasowski
sources.published: 30 May 2018 (Commons upload); first Flickr publication not verified
sources.limitation: Earlier-event appearance reference only. This is not a 2015 observation or a photograph of Kim Il Sung Square. Visible tracks, turret and long barrel establish tank-like appearance; exact model is not independently verified. Camera coordinate 125.773750, 39.022869 is outside the selected square.

sources.title: Joint Security Area before demilitarization · 19 June 2018
sources.creator: Staff Sgt. Richard Colletta · U.S. Army / 20th Public Affairs Detachment
sources.captured: 19 June 2018 (DVIDS caption); raw EXIF 18 June 2018 20:00 without verified timezone
sources.region: Panmunjom Joint Security Area · view from the south
sources.rights: Public domain · U.S. official-duty photo; non-endorsement notice applies
sources.limitation: Blue conference buildings, Panmungak and Republic of Korea guards are directly visible. This predates the October 2018 changes and does not document an after-demilitarization deployment. The photographed ROK guards must not be described as DPRK soldiers. The appearance of U.S. Department of War (DoW) visual information does not imply or constitute DoW endorsement.

sources.title: North Korean guard at the Joint Security Area · 8 December 2017
sources.creator: MD111
sources.published: 10 April 2019 (Commons upload); first Flickr publication not verified
sources.region: Panmunjom Joint Security Area · photographed guard
sources.limitation: Direct period clothing and guard reference on one winter day. It does not establish staffing at every location or year. The depicted real person is not assigned a fictional thought; interactive guards are invented composites.

sources.title: Kim Il Sung Square from the Grand People’s Study House · 12 October 2018
sources.creator: Christophe95
sources.region: Kim Il Sung Square, Pyongyang · view from the west
sources.limitation: Direct 2018 spatial appearance reference, not a 2015 parade photo. Using it to illustrate the 2015 event setting is a cross-year inference. The source gives object coordinates 125.753640, 39.019520 and approximate camera coordinates 125.750050, 39.020140; camera and object coordinates are distinct.

sources.title: UNC verifies Joint Security Area demilitarization
sources.creator: United Nations Command
sources.rights: Link only · report text summarized; media not reused
sources.limitation: Documents weapons removal, a limit of 35 security personnel on each side and sealed guard posts after joint verification. It does not fix the precise positions or routines of generated guards. Changes apply to the JSA, not the entire DMZ.

sources.title: Contemporaneous report of the 10 October 2015 parade
sources.creator: Brian Padden · Voice of America
sources.rights: Link only · no media or article text reused
sources.limitation: Original reporter coverage describes the square, marching soldiers and tanks in the event. This is a report based on televised coverage, not a measured inventory, exact route or independently identified vehicle model.

visualReview.tank-photo: Two long gun barrels and green vehicle structures are visible. The foreground hides the chassis, tracks and wheels. The model and exact class are unverified; do not call this image a main battle tank.
